title: Iberian lead-plaque lexicon and 107 languages: replication data and programs
description:
Replication repository of the article The Lexicon of the Iberian Lead Plaques Compared with 107 Languages: A Statistical Comparison in Which Basque Ranks First (D. Martín Valladolid, 2026; 10.5281/zenodo.24443588). Data (with the Iberian word lists in CLDF format), criteria, algorithms, one program per table, functional specification, expected results, prior declarations and computational audits. Quick check: python3 4_programas/comprobacion_rapida.py; everything can also be run in the browser from the Colab notebook. Project website: iberico.martinva.org.

Repositorio de réplica del artículo «El léxico de los plomos ibéricos ante 107 lenguas: una comparación estadística en la que el euskera ocupa el primer lugar».
